dialogues.jp:
たまには、俺も水でもやってみようかと、空き
缶に水を汲んできた。
dialogues.en:
I arrived to the gym rear once again, with a can full of tap
water.
dialogues.text:
I arrived to the gym rear once again, with a can full of tap
water.

dialogues.jp: そもそも、あの草は元気がなさ過ぎる。
dialogues.en: That plant hasn't ever looked lively, even from the start.
dialogues.text: That plant hasn't ever looked lively, even from the start.

dialogues.jp:
初めて見た時には、枯れる寸前の雑草かと思っ
たくらいだ。
dialogues.en:
The first time I saw it, it looked like it was on the verge
of wilting.
dialogues.text:
The first time I saw it, it looked like it was on the verge
of wilting.

dialogues.jp: さて、ではさっそく、ボクから愛の雫を……。
dialogues.en: So, at once, take in my drops of love...
dialogues.text: So, at once, take in my drops of love...

dialogues.jp:
俺は、草の前にしゃがんで、缶の中の水を垂ら
そうと手を傾ける。
dialogues.en:
With the can held over the plant by my hand, I started to
tip the can over...
dialogues.text:
With the can held over the plant by my hand, I started to
tip the can over...

dialogues.jp: ──ガシッ
dialogues.en: --*grab*
dialogues.text: --*grab*

dialogues.jp: 俺の腕を黒い手袋をした小さな腕が掴む。
dialogues.en: A small, black-gloved hand latched onto my arm.
dialogues.text: A small, black-gloved hand latched onto my arm.

dialogues.en: "...Tsukishiro."
dialogues.text: "...Tsukishiro."

dialogues.jp:
そこにはいつの間にか月城がいて、俺の腕をしっ
かりと掴んでいた。
dialogues.en:
Who knows when she appeared, but she was holding tightly
onto my arm.
dialogues.text:
Who knows when she appeared, but she was holding tightly
onto my arm.

dialogues.jp:
そして、悲痛な表情で俺を見つめ、小さく首を
横に振った。
dialogues.en:
She was looking at me with a pained expression, shaking her
head no.
dialogues.text:
She was looking at me with a pained expression, shaking her
head no.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「あ……うん、わかった」
dialogues.en: "Ah... o, okay."
dialogues.text: "Ah... o, okay."

dialogues.jp:
月城の表情を見る限り、ただごとではなさそう
だ。俺は、素直に手を引っ込める。
dialogues.en:
Looking at Tsukishiro's face, I knew something was wrong
with what I was doing. I obediently drew back my hand.
dialogues.text:
Looking at Tsukishiro's face, I knew something was wrong
with what I was doing. I obediently drew back my hand.

dialogues.jp:
俺の意思が伝わったのか、月城はすぐに手を離
してくれた。
dialogues.en:
Seeing my intentions withdrawn, she released her death grip
on my arm.
dialogues.text:
Seeing my intentions withdrawn, she released her death grip
on my arm.

dialogues.jp: そして、手袋を外し、人形を触る。
dialogues.en:
And once again, the gloves came off, and the doll was
stroked gently.
dialogues.text:
And once again, the gloves came off, and the doll was
stroked gently.

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉先輩、こんちわ！　この花はね、あまり
　たくさん水をやったら、枯れちゃうんだ」
dialogues.en:
"Asakura-senpai, good afternoon! That flower, it'd wilt if
you give it too much water."
dialogues.text:
"Asakura-senpai, good afternoon! That flower, it'd wilt if
you give it too much water."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「そうだったのか」
dialogues.en: "I see."
dialogues.text: "I see."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「気持ちはありがたいけど……、必要ないんだ」
dialogues.en:
"Thank you for caring about it... but you don't need to do
that."
dialogues.text:
"Thank you for caring about it... but you don't need to do
that."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「そうか……、そりゃ勝手なことしようとして
　悪かったな」
dialogues.en: "Yeah... sorry, I was too impulsive."
dialogues.text: "Yeah... sorry, I was too impulsive."

dialogues.jp:
月城は、ちょっと申し訳なさそうな顔をしなが
ら、少し笑みを浮かべて、首を横に振った。
dialogues.en:
At my apology, Tsukishiro calmly shook her head, a tiny
smile forming on her lips.
dialogues.text:
At my apology, Tsukishiro calmly shook her head, a tiny
smile forming on her lips.

dialogues.jp: 「まあ、大事な草なんだろうしな」
dialogues.en: "Well, it's certainly an important flower."
dialogues.text: "Well, it's certainly an important flower."

dialogues.jp: こくん、と月城が頷いた。
dialogues.en: Another quick nod.
dialogues.text: Another quick nod.

dialogues.jp:
この草がなんなのか未だによくわからないけれ
ど月城が教えようとしてくれないところを見る
と、たぶん聞いてはいけないことなんだろう。
dialogues.en:
Although she probably knows how to take care of the flower
as much as I do, I couldn't ignore such a wholehearted
request.
dialogues.text:
Although she probably knows how to take care of the flower
as much as I do, I couldn't ignore such a wholehearted
request.

dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、俺、帰るから」
dialogues.en: "Alright then, I'm heading back."
dialogues.text: "Alright then, I'm heading back."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「帰るの？　先輩」
dialogues.en: "You're leaving already, senpai?"
dialogues.text: "You're leaving already, senpai?"

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「いやぁ、ちょっと水でもやってみようかと立
　ち寄っただけだしな」
dialogues.en: "Yeah. I just dropped by for a bit, to give it some water."
dialogues.text: "Yeah. I just dropped by for a bit, to give it some water."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「そっかぁ。明日はテストだしね」
dialogues.en: "Oh yes, tomorrow's the start of the tests."
dialogues.text: "Oh yes, tomorrow's the start of the tests."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「そういや、そうだったな」
dialogues.en: "Indeed."
dialogues.text: "Indeed."

dialogues.jp:
このまま帰ったところで、試験勉強をするだろ
うか。いや、しないだろうな。
dialogues.en:
Of course, going home now would mean putting in some
studying for the exams. Or trying to, anyway.
dialogues.text:
Of course, going home now would mean putting in some
studying for the exams. Or trying to, anyway.

dialogues.jp: 「月城は、試験勉強、平気なのか？」
dialogues.en: "Are your exam preparations going well, Tsukishiro?"
dialogues.text: "Are your exam preparations going well, Tsukishiro?"

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「アリスは大丈夫だよ。成績はいい方だからね」
dialogues.en: "Alice'd be fine. She always scores well."
dialogues.text: "Alice'd be fine. She always scores well."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「そっか、うらやましいね」
dialogues.en: "Heh, I'm a little jealous."
dialogues.text: "Heh, I'm a little jealous."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、ゆっくり立ち上がり、ん〜と背伸びをす
る。
dialogues.en: I slowly stood up, and stretched as long as I could.
dialogues.text: I slowly stood up, and stretched as long as I could.

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉先輩」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-senpai."
dialogues.text: "Asakura-senpai."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　なんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Hm? What's up?"
dialogues.text: "Hm? What's up?"

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「見に来るのは……いつでもいいからね」
dialogues.en: "You can come to look at it... whenever you want."
dialogues.text: "You can come to look at it... whenever you want."

dialogues.jp:
月城が、ちょっと傾けた顔で、俺の方を見てい
る。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro was looking at me, her head bowed down slightly.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro was looking at me, her head bowed down slightly.

dialogues.jp: 「ああ、そうだな。時々寄らせてもらうわ」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, got it. I'd visit every so often."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, got it. I'd visit every so often."

dialogues.jp: 「じゃあな」
dialogues.en: 'See ya."
dialogues.text: 'See ya."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあね」
dialogues.en: "See you!"
dialogues.text: "See you!"

dialogues.jp: 俺は、しゃがんでいる月城の頭を軽く撫でる。
dialogues.en:
I gave the still-squatting Tsukishiro a light pat on the
head.
dialogues.text:
I gave the still-squatting Tsukishiro a light pat on the
head.

dialogues.jp:
あまりに軽はずみだと、怒られるかと思ったが、
不思議と、月城は何も言わなかった。
dialogues.en:
It was admittedly rash again, and I thought she'd get mad,
but oddly, she didn't say a single thing.
dialogues.text:
It was admittedly rash again, and I thought she'd get mad,
but oddly, she didn't say a single thing.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、体育館裏を後にした。
dialogues.en: After that, I simply left the rear of the gym.
dialogues.text: After that, I simply left the rear of the gym.

dialogues.jp: ◆お節介だったかな◆
dialogues.en: ◆Busybody◆
dialogues.text: ◆Busybody◆

dialogues.jp:
たまには、あの草に水でもやろうと、じょうろ
を持ってやってきた。
dialogues.en:
Thinknig to give it some water once in a while, I brought a
used can of water with me.
dialogues.text:
Thinknig to give it some water once in a while, I brought a
used can of water with me.

dialogues.jp:
いざ、水をやろうとした瞬間、やってきた月城
に止められてしまった。どうやら、あまり水を
やってはいけないらしい。
dialogues.en:
Just as I was about to start pouring, Alice appeared out of
nowhere and stopped me. Seems like I can't give it too much
water.
dialogues.text:
Just as I was about to start pouring, Alice appeared out of
nowhere and stopped me. Seems like I can't give it too much
water.

dialogues.jp:
俺はお節介すぎたと反省したが、月城は俺に好
意的な言葉をかけてくれた。
dialogues.en:
Reflecting on my rashness, I apologized, and Tsukishiro
seemed to treat it favourably.
dialogues.text:
Reflecting on my rashness, I apologized, and Tsukishiro
seemed to treat it favourably.

dialogues.jp:
月城も少しは俺を認めてくれたということだろ
うか。
dialogues.en: Little by little, she seems to be accepting me.
dialogues.text: Little by little, she seems to be accepting me.
